monitoring.securityDashboardAlert: One-screen view of security events and open risks. Resolutions are written to the audit hash chain; enterprise compliance package only
monitoring.persistenceAlert: The gateway keeps data after restart by storing it in shared storage. Where to store is a one-time deployment decision (Redis / built-in database / local files); standalone deployments can ignore this tab
monitoring.templatesAlert: Vendor presets shared by provider selection and the template-based wizard. No daily changes needed
monitoring.categoriesAlert: Override default settings per model category. Defaults from global settings apply when empty
monitoring.adaptersAlert: Chosen automatically when connecting a new vendor; only needed when a vendor API is non-standard

securityDashboard.locked: Security Posture is not unlocked by the current license (enterprise compliance package)
securityDashboard.loadFailed: Failed to load posture data. Check that the enterprise license enables this capability
securityDashboard.resolveNoteTip: Provide a note. The resolution is recorded in the audit hash chain
securityDashboard.resolveConflict: Already resolved or missing. Refresh and retry
securityDashboard.noRisks: No high-risk events in this window

enterpriseAlert.evidence: Generate an evidence bundle for a time window and verify the hash chain; the bundle includes per-row self-checks for independent audit review
enterpriseAlert.archive: Archive list and integrity checks; destruction applies only to objects past retention and is recorded in the WORM manifest
enterpriseAlert.license: Read-only license runtime state; revocation is destructive and requires a valid serial plus reason; shared-state write failures are reported explicitly
enterpriseAlert.reconciliation: Billing differences are reported, never auto-corrected; resolution only moves OPEN to RESOLVED and the operator is recorded server-side
enterpriseAlert.agentTools: Register tool metadata, toggle availability and tenant grants; the gateway governs tools but never executes them
enterpriseAlert.guardrails: Runtime state and rule testing for DLP / KMS / moderation; state and tests never expose source text or key material
enterpriseAlert.alertChannels: Configure alert channel metadata and severities; delivery is handled by deployment sinks.
enterpriseAlert.groupRoles: Register stable department IDs and department-to-role allowlists. Only allowlisted roles can be assigned; IdP role pass-through is forbidden.
enterpriseAlert.promptTemplates: Maintain prompt templates, view version history and preview compositions. Composition only produces text and does not affect runtime routing.
enterpriseAlert.adapterLifecycle: Register adapter online/gray state and rollout percentage. Actual routing is driven by the strategy engine consuming these flags.
enterpriseAlert.keyApproval: Review and decide key requests. After approval an administrator issues the real key via the existing key creation flow.

tenantManagement.locked: Tenant management is not unlocked by the current license (enterprise edition)
tenantManagement.tip: A tenant ID cannot be changed after creation; disabling is soft-delete and keeps the audit trail. Switching tenants adds the matching X-Tenant-Id to later requests
tenantManagement.idHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only, 1-63 characters
tenantManagement.disableConfirm: Disable tenant {id}? It can no longer be used; audit records are preserved
tenantManagement.isolationTip: After switching tenants, make a request from Observability or Playground to confirm each tenant sees only its own data

evidence.locked: Audit hash chain is not unlocked by the current license (enterprise compliance package)
evidence.chainBroken: Chain verification failed; inspect the first bad row
evidence.timeHint: ISO-8601 local time (e.g. 2026-11-16T00:00:00); the bundle contains chain snapshots, per-row checks and segment integrity
evidence.noEntries: No chain rows in this window

archive.locked: WORM archive is not unlocked by the current license (enterprise compliance package)
archive.disclaimer: Soft WORM protects against accidental deletion, overwrite and ordinary tampering, not against privileged writers; never market it as hardware-grade immutability
archive.invalidRange: Invalid range: start must be >= 1 and <= end
archive.archiveSkipped: Nothing to archive in this range
archive.destroyConfirm: Destroy archive {name}? This cannot be undone
archive.reasonPlaceholder: Reason (will be written to the WORM manifest)
archive.name: Object
archive.manualHint: Up to 1000 rows per batch; the scheduled job archives incrementally, so manual runs are rarely needed

licenseOps.locked: Enterprise licensing is not enabled in this deployment
licenseOps.revokeRequired: Serial and reason are both required
licenseOps.revokeConfirm: Revoke license {serial}? Revocation blocks requests; confirm a replacement license is ready
licenseOps.clearConfirm: Clear the current revocation? Only for a replacement license or a mistake
licenseOps.hint: Revocation is broadcast through shared storage; if the write fails the backend reports an error and no revocation takes effect. Never treat that as success

reconciliation.locked: Commercial billing (reconciliation) is not unlocked by the current license
reconciliation.resolveConfirm: Resolve difference {key}? Only OPEN to RESOLVED is allowed
reconciliation.resolveConflict: Already resolved or missing; refresh and retry
reconciliation.disclaimer: Differences are reported, never auto-corrected; use 2026-11-16T00:00:00 format, blank means last 24 hours

agentTools.locked: Agent tool governance is not unlocked by the current license
agentTools.name: Tool name
agentTools.tenantsPlaceholder: Blank means all tenants; separate multiple IDs with commas
agentTools.tip: The registry governs availability and tenant scope only; it never executes tools. Disabled tools are treated as unregistered
agentTools.deleteConfirm: Unregister tool {name}? It will be treated as unregistered immediately
agentTools.tenantsTip: Allowed tenant IDs, comma-separated; blank means all tenants

guardrails.tip: State and tests never expose source text, term lists, regexes or key material; tests emit no audit events and do not pollute the hash chain
guardrails.dlpLocked: DLP is not unlocked by the current license
guardrails.kmsHint: Only algorithm and versions are shown; key material is never returned
guardrails.kmsLocked: KMS is not unlocked by the current license
guardrails.moderationLocked: Moderation is not unlocked by the current license
guardrails.samplePlaceholder: Sample text for this test only; never logged or audited
guardrails.testHint: Tests use the real engine but return only a verdict, never source text or matched fragments

securityReport.tip: This page summarizes authentication and audit events over a period into a downloadable security report for compliance evidence and demos. It is an open-source audit capability and needs no enterprise license.
securityReport.title: Security Report
securityReport.noAlerts: No security alerts in this period
securityReport.empty: Pick a range and click Generate

alertChannels.tip: Register metadata and enabled severities for outbound alert channels. The enterprise jar bundles no network client; delivery is handled by deployment-provided alert sinks. Test returns reachability only and never echoes credentials.
alertChannels.title: Alert Channels
alertChannels.name: Name
alertChannels.targetPlaceholder: Webhook URL or recipient; keep secrets in the external sink
alertChannels.empty: No channels yet. Click Add channel to start.
alertChannels.locked: Security Posture is not enabled in the current license; alert channel config is unavailable
alertChannels.required: Channel ID and name are required
alertChannels.deleteConfirm: Delete channel {name}? This cannot be undone.

promptTemplates.tip: Maintain prompt templates, view version history and preview compositions. Saving the same id keeps the old version. Composition only produces text and does not affect routing.
promptTemplates.title: Prompt Templates
promptTemplates.name: Name
promptTemplates.empty: No templates yet. Click Add template to start.

adapterLifecycle.tip: Register adapter online/gray state, rollout percentage and target version. Only metadata is maintained here; actual routing is driven by the strategy engine.
adapterLifecycle.title: Adapter Lifecycle

keyApproval.tip: Review and decide key requests submitted by staff. After approval an administrator issues the real key via the existing Create Key flow. Virtual/masked key support is already available in OSS.
keyApproval.title: Key Approvals

groupRole.tip: Register stable department IDs and configure an allowed-role allowlist per department. Account role assignment only picks allowlisted roles; IdP role pass-through is forbidden.
groupRole.empty: No departments yet. Register one to start.
